title: Tool-neutral testing, verification and CI/CD evidence contract
objective: Deliver the approved coherent testing/quality and CI/CD documentation expansion with reusable templates, safe distribution, independent verification and a reviewable PR.
approved_sources: User authorization 2026-10-21: combine agreed testing/quality and CI/CD proposals into one PR.

acceptance.description: Accurate primary-source provenance and distinction between norms, methods and local rules.
Reusable original testing templates and coherent hypothetical example without invented evidence.
Status, applicability, evidence freshness and gate meanings preserve closed schemas and stronger duties.
CI/CD evidence mapping accurately covers current support, adoption and operational boundaries.
Real source/rendered copy/update/negative compatibility checks preserve project ownership and protected contracts.
Independent checks/reviews/triage and actual published PR/readback with unresolved evidence explicit.

manual_evidence: Frozen independent behavior and authority Full reviews, separate triage and Delta if required
Actual PR publication and remote-check readback

stop_conditions: Scope, acceptance or trust-boundary expansion requires updated independent plan review.
Stop on conflicting authorities, unknown mandatory context or exhausted review budget.
At most two Full rounds for the same scope; triage before repair.
forbidden_actions: No merge, release, deploy, runner provisioning, protection or permission changes.
No schema/catalog/runtime/workflow YAML changes, new result engine or generalized scheduler.
No fabricated PASS, weakened gates, historical fixture/report rewrites or automatic downstream application.
No hosted-runner fallback or GitHub artifact uploads.
